The keyframe note explains the drop with the page's quotes, so it is acknowledged, not silent.

944 Edessa (c2): the page says 'reconquest of Edessa (944)', but the 944 event was the surrender of the Mandylion for a truce. The city was annexed in 1031/1032 by George Maniakes, and Cliopatria draws it Byzantine only from 970.
936 Melitene (c2): the page gives no year for Melitene; the usual date is 934.
960 Cyprus (c1): the usual date is 965 (Niketas Chalkoutzes).
962 Cilicia (now c1): Adana, Mopsuestia and Tarsus fell in 964-965.
970 Antioch (c1): the city was taken in October 969.
718 Balearics and Ceuta (c1): the Balearics stayed nominally Byzantine until the Cordoban conquest of 902-903; Ceuta fell c. 710.
1016 gain of Sevastopol (c2): Cherson was Byzantine before 1016. The 1016 expedition was against Georgius Tzul in eastern Crimea (Kerch).
1139 Cilicia (c1): John II's Cilician campaign was in 1137.
1188 Sirmium, Bosnia and Dalmatia (c1): Bela III took them back in 1180-1181.
1192 Cyprus (c1): the island seceded under Isaac Komnenos in 1184 and was taken by Richard I in 1191.
1314 Rhodes (c1): the Hospitaller conquest was in 1306-1310.
1352 Serbian conquests (c1): Dusan's conquests ran 1342-1348. Thessaly (gained 1333) has no later loss event; Serbia took it in 1348.
1385 Serres (c1): Serres was Serbian from 1345 and Ottoman from 1383, so not Byzantine in 1345-1385.
1403 Thessalonica (c1): the Treaty of Gallipoli is undated on the cited page.
